content.passage: Are you looking for fine dining at an affordable price? Stop by Mr. Wu's Chinese Restaurant, located downtown on Main Street. We are famous for our dumplings, noodles, and desserts. For your convenience, our restaurant offers takeout and delivery services!

And now for this week's weather forecast. In the Midvale region, we are expecting heavy rain, lower temperatures, and wind from the northwest. Because rainfall last month was much lower than expected, this forecast should be welcome news to our local farmers.
